name: CED - South Burlington
old_description: Our local strength scales to the national level – an account at CED Burlington plugs you into our network throughout the country, gaining you access to the hard-to-find items you need to get you off the job site.
about:
CED Burlington operates from Williston, Vermont, as a branch of Consolidated Electrical Distributors (CED), a national network that traces its roots to a single location opened in California in 1957. The family of companies has grown to nearly 800 locations across the United States, each empowered to make local stocking and service decisions.

The Williston location functions as a full-line electrical distributor and service provider. It stocks gear packages, load centers, disconnects, meter mains, circuit breakers and related protective devices from major manufacturers. Beyond product supply, the branch offers residential lighting design through a licensed designer, detailed takeoff services from electrical drawings, job management with custom reporting, and customer storage that holds palletized materials for just-in-time delivery. Emergency same-day delivery and after-hours availability round out the service portfolio.

Primary customers include residential and commercial electrical contractors, as well as construction firms handling service entrance equipment and switchgear assemblies. The branch positions itself as the "Residential Contractors' Supplier of Choice" in its market, while also supporting larger infrastructure projects through the national CED network.

The company emphasizes a motto of "Service. Integrity. Reliability." and credits its growth to decentralized decision-making that keeps inventory and expertise close to the job site. Differentiators cited by the branch include next-day UPS Red Label shipping on many stocked items, a licensed lighting designer on staff, and a willingness to deliver materials outside normal business hours.
